summary: **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** The Petitioner, Mundra I Transmission Limited, has filed the present Petition for (hereinafter referred to as “the Act”) read with the Central Electricity Regulatory _“a) Issue / Grant the Transmission License to the Petitioner for establishing, operating and maintaining the Transmission System as provided for in the Transmission Service Agreement;_ _b) Allow the “Transmission system for supply of power to Green Hydrogen/Ammonia manufacturing potential in Mundra area of Gujarat under Phase-I: Part B1 scheme (3 GW at Navinal S/s)” to be part of PoC Pool as per Hon'ble CERC (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 and any other amendments thereon issued from time to time by Hon'ble Commission._ _c) Condone any inadvertent errors omissions/ errors / shortcomings and permit the Petitioner to add/change/modify/alter these filings and make further submissions as may be required at a future date._ _d) Pass any such other order / orders, as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ 3. Notice was issued to the parties to file the reply and rejoinder. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing dated 20.5.2025, the Petitioner was directed to implead POWERGRID (for Bhuj PS) and Adani Energy Solutions Ltd., the TSP of Navinal (for the Mundra S/s) as a party to the Petition and to file a revised memo of parties. Accordingly, the Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 23.5.2025, has filed the revised memo of parties. Further, CTUIL was directed to furnish details of the interconnecting upstream and downstream transmission systems, as well as the connectivity details and GNA grants and/or applications received at Navinal (Mundra) S/s. 4. The representative of Respondent, CTUIL, submitted that CTUIL has also filed its compliance affidavit as per the Record of Proceedings for the hearing dated 20.5.2025 and that no application for GNA has been received from Green Hydrogen/ Ammonia manufacturers in the Mundra area of Gujarat to date. He accordingly requested that the matter be reserved for orders. Further, in response to a specific query of the Commission regarding the planning of the transmission system involved in the present cases, the representative of CTUIL submitted that the said transmission system has been planned on a prospective basis for potential green hydrogen/ green ammonia manufacturers in the Navinal area and, as on date, no application for the grant of connectivity (GNA) has been received from such entities. The Petitioner entered into a Transmission Service Agreement (TSA) with CTUIL on 20.3.2025. 16. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner, BPC, and CTUIL.
